name: save-boot-20d-world-save-load
description: #228: a world-map save made in game loads back after a restart. Plays save-boot-20a-world-save-circle's script unchanged, without its wait's metric name (load disc1-wm1-kalm, close the entry window, Triangle until the world loop's menu state, 600 frames, the planned Up to Save, Circle ×8, 120 frames: the game overwrites file 1). Then a restart step: the title boot point's state again, with the card as the game left it (the card is flagged as new, as for a save boot). Then load as save-boot-7-world-kalm does: Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState reads 3 (w_state), 600 frames, three Circle presses a second apart, window 0 reads 0 (win_ok: frames waited), 60 frames, a mark, 60 frames of Down+Left, 10 still. Checks: g_GameState 3 (world_ok); g_FieldCurrentMap names location 2 (map_ok); the player's pos.vx changed since the mark (x_dir: the sign only); the card check over the whole script (card_ok: slot 1 changed and holds a world-map save with a right checksum; c_data: 1 if that slot's savemap bytes changed, so the game rewrote the save and not only its directory frame); a rerun from the same snapshot, restart included, ends in the same state (match). The generated save is also a world-map save at location 2, which is why card_ok and c_data are reported with the load. Only numbers leave.
